changeSet.author: pilotage

column.name: delai_max_jours
column.remarks: Délai maximal (D-106) ; NULL = égal au délai cible.

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE processus ADD CONSTRAINT ck_processus_delai_max CHECK (delai_max_jours IS NULL OR (delai_max_jours BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND (delai_cible_jours IS NULL OR delai_max_jours >= delai_cible_jours)));

changeSet.author: pilotage

column.name: echeance_cible
column.remarks: Échéance cible (D-106) ; echeance est l'échéance maximale.

changeSet.sql: UPDATE processus_etape_instance SET echeance_cible = echeance WHERE echeance_cible IS NULL AND echeance IS NOT NULL;
